description: Find a jurisdiction by two-letter state code and literal jurisdiction name substring. Returns coded equipment answers self-reported in the EAC's 2024 Election Administration and Voting Survey (November 2024), with make/model and MORVS-curated vendor labels. Missing and coded Other answers do not mean no equipment. The survey does not establish equipment used on 2026-11-03; check Verified Voting and the state election office. Vendor counts overlap and must not be summed. Say voters participated in jurisdictions that reported a vendor's equipment; never say that vendor counted those votes.

jurisdiction.description: Optional case-insensitive jurisdiction name substring, at most 80 characters.

state.description: Required two-letter state or territory code from the EAC 2024 survey.

name: election_equipment_jurisdiction
title: Find Election Equipment by Jurisdiction
